name: Cottage on the Moor
source: Cottage on the Moor tells the tale of a young writer on a trip to freshen his mind. Wandering a salt marsh far from civilization, he stumbles upon a small cottage inhabited by a middle-aged woman and her daughter. It seems he has found something more than just inspiration for his next story.
translation: 《荒原小屋》讲述一名年轻作家为放松心情而旅行的故事。他在远离文明的盐沼中漫步，偶然发现一座小屋，里面住着一名中年女性和她的女儿。看来，他找到的不只是下一部作品的灵感。
